metas.name: 1 · ★ 8.1 · 1973 · The Exorcist
metas.description: When a mysterious entity possesses a young girl, her mother seeks the help of two Catholic priests to save her life.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 3.8 · 1977 · Exorcist II: The Heretic
metas.description: A teenage girl once possessed by a demon finds that it still lurks within her. Meanwhile, a priest investigates the death of the girl's exorcist.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.6 · 1990 · The Exorcist III
metas.description: A police lieutenant uncovers more than he bargained for as his investigation of a series of murders, which have all the hallmarks of the deceased Gemini serial killer, leads him to question the patients of a psychiatric ward.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 5.1 · 2004 · Exorcist: The Beginning
metas.description: In 1947, having abandoned his faith, Father Merrin joins an archaeological excavation in Kenya, where an ancient church has been unearthed and something much older waits to be awoken.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 5.1 · 2005 · Dominion: Prequel to the Exorcist
metas.description: Decades before Father Merrin helped save Regan MacNeil's soul, he first encounters the demon Pazuzu in Kenya. Merrin's initial battle with Pazuzu leads to the rediscovery of his faith.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 4.8 · 2023 · The Exorcist: Believer
metas.description: When two girls disappear into the woods and return three days later with no memory of what happened to them, the father of one girl seeks out Chris MacNeil, who's been forever altered by what happened to her daughter fifty years ago.
